[PREFERENCE] User asked for recipes for making yogurt in a slow cooker.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided a slow cooker yogurt recipe with the following details:  
[ASSISTANT] - Ingredients: 1/2 gallon milk (whole, low-fat, or nonfat), 1/4 cup plain yogurt with live cultures, optional sweeteners and flavorings.  
[ASSISTANT] - Instructions: Heat milk to 180°F to 185°F, cool to 110°F to 120°F, add yogurt starter, incubate for 8-12 hours, chill and store.  
[ASSISTANT] - Tips: Use a thermometer, experiment with different milks, add flavorings, thicken yogurt with gelatin, make Greek yogurt by straining.  
[PREFERENCE] User inquired about the necessity of using a thermometer versus just waiting for the milk to heat up.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant explained the importance of temperature in yogurt making, including killing bacteria and denaturing proteins.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant noted that using a thermometer ensures accurate temperature control and consistent results.  
[PREFERENCE] User expressed interest in vegan yogurt alternatives for use as a base for slow cooker yogurt.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided a list of vegan yogurt alternatives, including:  
[ASSISTANT] - Soy Yogurt  
[ASSISTANT] - Coconut Yogurt  
[ASSISTANT] - Almond Yogurt  
[ASSISTANT] - Cashew Yogurt  
[ASSISTANT] - Oat Yogurt  
[ASSISTANT] - Rice Yogurt  
[ASSISTANT] - Hemp Yogurt  
[ASSISTANT] - Flax Yogurt  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant recommended selecting unflavored and unsweetened varieties of vegan yogurt alternatives.
